'''Yang Wantai''' ({{zh|s=杨万泰|t=楊萬泰|p=Yáng Wàntài}}; born October 1956) is a Chinese chemist and professor at [[Beijing University of Chemical Technology]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.cmse.buct.edu.cn/dd/jsjl/js_zgz/32099.htm |script-title=zh:杨万泰 教授 |work=cmse.buct.edu.cn |date=2013-05-24 |language=zh |archive-date=2018-06-26 |access-date=2018-10-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180626021714/http://www.cmse.buct.edu.cn/dd/jsjl/js_zgz/32099.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Biography==
Yang was born in [[Cheng'an County]], [[Hebei]], in October 1956. After resuming the college entrance examination, he was accepted to [[Tsinghua University]], where he majored in chemistry. He earned a master's degree from [[Beijing University of Chemical Technology]], after his graduation he worked in the university. In April 1996 he received his doctor's degree from the [[KTH Royal Institute of Technology]]. 

He was dean of the School of Materials, Beijing University of Chemical Technology from 2005 to 2016. In 2013 he was appointed director of Beijing Laboratory of Biomedical Materials. He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] on November 28, 2017.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.casad.cas.cn/doc/17503.html |script-title=zh:关于公布2017年中国科学院院士增选当选院士名单的公告 |work=cas.cn |date=2017-11-28 |language=zh |archive-date=2018-08-01 |access-date=2018-10-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180801191730/http://www.casad.cas.cn/doc/17503.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
